body.name: Psi_k
body.def: \(\Psi_k=\sum_{s=1}^{S}\pi_s\sum_{t\in J_k}w_{st}\{\overline Q_{st}-\widehat m_s^{(-k)}(X_{st})\}\), where \(\overline Q_{st}=n_s^{-1}\sum_iQ_{sti}\) and \(\widehat m_s^{(-k)}\) is trained on retained blocks of parity opposite to \(k\); set \(\Psi_k=0\) whenever a required cross-fit quantity has its bookkeeping value, and invoke the full-range interval branch.
